text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: horizonclient — sudden QPS spike (4.2x baseline), 5xxs rising to ~6%, 95p latency >1.2s. Paging eng-sre oncall @morgan :rotating_light: INC-2026-0457

morgan: ack — I'm on it. Gathering metrics and impact. Can infra apply an org-level soft throttle (10 RPS) and disable the horizon-embed feature flag?

kevin: +1. Seeing KV cache pressure on gpu-serving-2. Soft throttle + disable embed should relieve tail. I can push RL change via admin API now.

morgan: do it. Make it a soft limit (return 429 + Retry-After 10), burst=20. Post the exact curl you run so CS/public comms can reference.

kevin: running:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.ai/orgs/horizonclient/rate-limit -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"limit":10,"burst":20,"mode":"soft"}'
```
Applying change and disabling embed flag: ff:horizon-embed -> false

ops-bot: change applied (change-id ch_2026_778). Soft limit=10rps, burst=20. Feature flag horizon-embed disabled.

morgan: monitoring... initial signal good — 95p latency down to ~430ms, 5xxs down to ~1.2%. Michelle, can you confirm CS notified and whether we need an external message?

michelle: CS notified, ticket CS-5421 created. Draft message: "We're mitigating a traffic surge affecting some requests; you may see delayed responses. We're prioritizing stability and will update shortly." Approving to send if metrics remain stable for 10m.

eli: routing fallback enabled to model-small; ~18% of traffic shifted off large-model pool. KV cache miss rate dropping.

morgan: handing over follow-up to night oncall @kevin in 30m. Rollback plan: if errors <0.5% and 95p <600ms for 30m, gradually increase limit back by +5rps every 10m. If errors >2% or 95p >700ms, escalate to infra lead.

kevin: ack. I'll watch for error spikes and confirm rollback window. If anything regresses I'll revert feature flag and raise the incident.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0457 updated: mitigation_applied -> monitoring.

morgan: marking channel for monitoring. Will close after two 10m stable windows. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
